facts.fact: Starlink sells residential (N57,000/month), Business Priority (N159,000) and Roam plans in Nigeria as of April 2026; residential orders paused in congested Lagos and Abuja areas but open in Port Harcourt, Benin City, Ibadan, Enugu, Kaduna.
Starlink activated a ground station at Okun Aja, Lagos State, with 20 antennas, which reopened residential activations in Port Harcourt and Benin City (date not given; article date used).
